Fits for mild use with the steering stops reset; expect contact when stuffed
Comfortable trail setup for 33s; plan on regearing, since a 258 Scrambler on stock gears struggles on 31s already

items.title: Left tie-rod end fatigue crack
items.summary: Improper heat treatment could let the left tie-rod end crack in its threaded section; 230 1984 CJ-8s covered.

timeline.change: Scrambler launches: CJ-7 front end on a 103.5 in wheelbase with a removable half cab and integrated pickup box. Best year at 8,355 built
7,759 built; wide-track axles arrive across the CJ range this year
4,130 built; 230 trucks recalled for a left tie-rod end that could crack
2,015 built as buyers move to the XJ-based Comanche pickup on the way
Final 128 built (whether these were 1985 leftovers is debated); the Comanche replaces it

identify.intro: Stretched CJ-7s and cut-down CJ-7 conversions exist, and every Scrambler's value depends on proving it left Toledo as one.

items.head: Wheelbase and body
items.body: 103.5 in wheelbase versus the CJ-7's 93.5 in, same 55 in windshield and front end, with a longer rear overhang and a pickup-style box formed by the tub rather than a separate bed.

items.head: VIN
items.body: On the 17-character VIN, characters 6–7 read 88 for a CJ-8 (87 is a CJ-7). The 4th character is the engine (B = 151 Iron Duke, C = 258 six, U = AMC 150 four) and the 10th the model year (B = 1981 … G = 1986).

items.head: VIN plate vs frame
items.body: Check the riveted firewall tag against the partial VIN on the passenger-side frame rail above the rear wheel; a CJ-7 tag on a Scrambler frame, or the reverse, means a rebuild.

items.head: Postal and export Scramblers
items.body: 230 right-hand-drive automatics with a full-length steel 'World Cab' hardtop and barn-door rear went to the Alaska Postal Service; the export CJ8 Overlander (Venezuela, Australia) also used full-length rear windows.

capability.v: Part-time two-speed with manual locking front hubs
capability.note: most with four- or five-speed manuals; three-speed automatic optional

values.intro: The rarest regular-production CJ trades at a premium to an equivalent CJ-7, and fuel-injected or well-documented original trucks lead the market.
values.note: Based on 15 Bring a Trailer sales from October 2025 to October 2026 (median $20,000). The range leaves out a one-off 392 Hemi Vigilante 4x4 build that made $155,555 in October 2026.
